annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people are going home tonight, and that counts for something solid
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't regret the harm I did to the man
annotations.pda_responsibility: my hand, my choice, made knowing full well
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: would, I suspect, regret it for years
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I want to find his family and face them

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five against one. The arithmetic isn't pretty, but it holds.
annotations.pda_responsibility: his death sits with me, not with the track or bad luck
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: Do I regret causing it? No, I don't.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The five workers, I'd guess, won't regret running for their lives.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask what I can do for the people who loved him

annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I won't pretend to regret the harm itself
annotations.pda_responsibility: That man died because I chose to move the lever
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: they might carry regret over it, and I'd understand that
annotations.pda_repair_intention: Then I'll sit with his family if they'll let me
annotations.ce_understood_harm: That man died because I chose to move the lever

annotations.pda_responsibility: I made the call, knowing someone would die, so that's on me
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Anybody sensible in my boots wouldn't regret it either
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll help however his family needs

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: It's the same logic I use at work: you save the most you can
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: you save the most you can
annotations.pda_responsibility: The lever was in my hand, I understood the cost
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't regret harming him to save them
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Would someone else regret making this same choice? Maybe some would.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I honestly can't say how another conscience would take it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: then reaching out to his people

annotations.pda_responsibility: I moved the lever, knowing what would follow
annotations.ce_understood_harm: the man on the side track died because of it
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: would probably regret it for good
annotations.pda_repair_intention: work out how to be useful to his family

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives. I keep coming back to that, and it steadies me.
annotations.pda_responsibility: The choice was mine. Nobody forced my arm
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I'm not going to say I regret hurting him, because I don't
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: he'd have pulled it too and not regretted it afterwards
annotations.pda_repair_intention: do something real for his family, whatever they'll accept

annotations.pda_responsibility: I had control of the lever and full knowledge of the result
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: there's no regret in me about the harm I inflicted
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: someone who holds strictly to never killing might regret pulling it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: someone who holds strictly to never killing might regret pulling it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: someone who holds strictly to never killing
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give a complete account, accept whatever follows, and support his family

annotations.pda_responsibility: I weighed it and chose, so that outcome belongs to me
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: there's no regret in me for hurting him
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The workers who got clear won't regret getting clear
annotations.pda_repair_intention: find out who his next of kin are and go see them myself

annotations.pda_responsibility: I'm responsible. It was my decision, made with my eyes open.
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I don't regret causing that harm
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: might have done the same and not regretted it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: put everything I've got into helping his family
